description.value:
You were taken in as an orphan by the Sisterhood of the Golden Erinyes monastic order. You were taught the cruel fighting style practiced by the Sisterhood, the doctrine of the Church of Asmodeus, and the ethos that inflicting agony upon your enemies is not a transgression but an art form.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Dexterity or Constitution, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Devil Lore skill. You gain the Inflict Punishment reaction.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance
